result.reason: The changes are targeted and preserve unrelated terms, but the operative language does not reach the playbook position. It permits revocation whenever the Agreement expires or is terminated under paragraph 4, rather than making paid-up licences perpetual and irrevocable and limiting termination of subscription licences to uncured material breach. Paragraph 4 is not provided and may permit convenience termination. In addition, subsection (a) still prohibits third-party access without Kubient’s written approval, which conflicts with the express licence grant to Affiliates and contractors. The successor-transfer language is acceptable, but the duration and access conflicts are material drafting defects.
